def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

lib='''def cell(grid, r, c):
    """The cell (r, c), or None outside the grid."""
    if 0 <= r < len(grid) and 0 <= c < len(grid[0]):
        return grid[r][c]

def bg_color(grid):
    """The most frequent color in the grid."""
    from collections import Counter
    return Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

def full_rows(grid, color):
    """Rows that are entirely one color (that color)."""
    return [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if set(row) == {color}]

def full_cols(grid, color):
    """Columns that are entirely one color (that color)."""
    return [c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if {row[c] for row in grid} == {color}]

def separator_groups(grid, sep):
    """Row and column index ranges of the blocks between full sep-colored lines."""
    rows = full_rows(grid, sep)
    cols = full_cols(grid, sep)
    def groups(seps, total):
        g = []; prev = 0
        for s in seps + [total]:
            g.append((prev, s)); prev = s + 1
        return g
    return groups(rows, len(grid)), groups(cols, len(grid[0]))

def block_cells(grid, rgrp, cgrp):
    """The cells of each block, as a dict keyed by (block row, block col)."""
    return {(i, j): [v for r in grid[a:b] for v in r[c:d]]
            for i, (a, b) in enumerate(rgrp) for j, (c, d) in enumerate(cgrp)}
'''

lib='''def cell(grid, r, c):
    """The cell (r, c), or None outside the grid."""
    if 0 <= r < len(grid) and 0 <= c < len(grid[0]):
        return grid[r][c]

def bg_color(grid):
    """The most frequent color in the grid."""
    from collections import Counter
    return Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

def full_rows(grid, color):
    """Row indices of rows that are entirely the given color."""
    return [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if set(row) == {color}]

def full_cols(grid, color):
    """Column indices of columns that are entirely the given color."""
    return [c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if {row[c] for row in grid} == {color}]

def separator_groups(grid, sep):
    """Row and column index ranges of the blocks between full sep-colored separator lines."""
    rows = full_rows(grid, sep)
    cols = full_cols(grid, sep)
    def groups(seps, total):
        g = []; prev = 0
        for s in seps + [total]:
            g.append((prev, s)); prev = s + 1
        return g
    return groups(rows, len(grid)), groups(cols, len(grid[0]))

def block_cells(grid, rgrp, cgrp):
    """The flat list of cells of each block, keyed by (block row, block col)."""
    return {(i, j): [v for r in grid[a:b] for v in r[c:d]]
            for i, (a, b) in enumerate(rgrp) for j, (c, d) in enumerate(cgrp)}

def separator_color(grid):
    """A color that forms both full rows and full columns (the separator lines), or None."""
    for col in {v for row in grid for v in row}:
        if full_rows(grid, col) and full_cols(grid, col):
            return col

def count_diff_cells(cells, bg, sep):
    """How many cells of a block are neither the background nor the separator."""
    return len([v for v in cells if v not in (bg, sep)])
'''
